title: PremiseRecord
description: One premise of the problem, classified. The ledger is the set of these at a version. Single writer: Framer (Frame). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

class.description: law: cannot be otherwise. maths: follows from definitions. policy: someone chose it and could choose otherwise. habit: nobody chose it. unverified: stated as fact, not yet checked. verified: checked, with a MeasurementRecord behind it.

source.description: Where the premise came from: the statement, the repository, the library, a measurement id.

cheapest_verification.description: The cheapest check that would change this premise's class. Required for unverified premises; 'none' otherwise.

load_bearing.description: True if the current best answer depends on this premise.

supersedes.description: Id of the PremiseRecord this one replaces, when a premise changes class or is merged.
